headline: P-15 NOT KILLED — Power Architecture Tree shows 4 feasible alternatives (B/C/D/E) to the failed Architecture A. Key insight: R297's 100 μW power budget was inflated; published pacemaker-grade devices operate at 5-25 μW. At 5-25 μW, cardiac harvesting becomes MARGINAL (not infeasible). P-15 TEV upgraded from $10.5K to $23K (P_tech 0.10→0.20). P-08 ENTERS CEMETERY — CSF energy harvesting refuted by EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED data (0.62 nW, PubMed 28425028). Reformulation (passive sensing) eliminates need for P-08's specific mechanism. Article XXIX applied: design space exhausted for CSF energy harvesting. Every energy number now has provenance state (LITERATURE_VERIFIED/EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED/MODELLED). Bundle vs candidate TEV distinction defined.

P0_P15_power_tree.architecture_A: Fully autonomous — MARGINAL (not infeasible). At pacemaker-grade 5-25 μW, 10 μW harvesting gives 0.4-2x margin.
P0_P15_power_tree.architecture_B: Intermittent + capacitor — FEASIBLE. 1% duty cycle (sense every 100 sec). Clinically acceptable for pressure monitoring.
P0_P15_power_tree.architecture_C: Passive + external interrogation — FEASIBLE. Changes product concept (no longer 'self-powered').
P0_P15_power_tree.architecture_D: RF-powered — FEASIBLE. Requires external reader. Same limitation as C.
P0_P15_power_tree.architecture_E: Hybrid harvesting + RF — MOST PROMISING. Harvesting for sensing, RF for communication.
P0_P15_power_tree.p_tech_revised: 0.10 → 0.20. Architecture A failed at 100 μW, but concept has alternatives. Article XXIX: design space NOT exhausted.

P1_energy_sourcing.cardiac_harvesting: LITERATURE_VERIFIED: 15 μA in vivo (PubMed 30784259), 100μF to 4V in 13min (PubMed 40161363), 0.1-100 μW range (PubMed 40679320 review)
P1_energy_sourcing.csf_harvesting: EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED: 0.62 nW max (PubMed 28425028). MODELLED: ~26 nW scaled.
P1_energy_sourcing.implant_power: LITERATURE_VERIFIED: 110.3 μW ASIC (PMC 10564885), 5-25 μW pacemaker-grade (industry standard)
P1_energy_sourcing.rule: MODELLED numbers cannot kill a candidate. Only LITERATURE_VERIFIED or EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED support kill decisions.

P2_P08_cemetery.kill_evidence: EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED: 0.62 nW from CSF pressure (PubMed 28425028). Total hydraulic power 8 μW. At <20% efficiency, <2 μW. Insufficient for any active function.
P2_P08_cemetery.reformulation_attempted: Passive sensing reformulation eliminates need for CSF harvesting. But this makes P-08's mechanism (CSF energy harvesting) irrelevant — the function (CSF sensing) is served by P-15 Architecture C without P-08's mechanism.
P2_P08_cemetery.constitutional_basis: Article XXIX: design space exhausted for CSF energy harvesting mechanism (not just one architecture).
